description:
Welcome to Hirashya UG19, a romantic 1BHK serviced apartment located in the heart of Candolim, Goa. This cozy retreat features a private jacuzzi, perfect for couples looking for a relaxing getaway.

The apartment is tastefully furnished with modern amenities and warm décor. Enjoy the spacious living area with comfortable seating, a fully equipped kitchen, and a bedroom with premium bedding. The highlight of the apartment is the private jacuzzi, perfect for unwinding after a day exploring Goa's beautiful beaches.

Located just minutes from Candolim Beach, you'll have easy access to restaurants, shops, and nightlife. The apartment also features high-speed WiFi, air conditioning, and a dedicated workspace.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: Amazing place! The jacuzzi was the highlight of our trip. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and perfectly located near the beach. Jeremie and Chloe were wonderful hosts.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: Perfect romantic getaway. The apartment exceeded our expectations. Beautifully decorated, spotlessly clean, and the private jacuzzi was a real treat. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Priya
reviews.text: Great location and lovely apartment. The jacuzzi was amazing. Only minor issue was the WiFi speed, but everything else was perfect. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: David
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place. The hosts were incredibly responsive and helpful. The apartment was exactly as described, and the jacuzzi was the cherry on top. Perfect for our anniversary trip.

reviews.author: Ananya
reviews.text: Stunning apartment in a prime location. Walking distance to the beach and great restaurants. The interior design is beautiful and the bed was super comfortable.

reviews.author: James
reviews.text: We had an incredible stay! The apartment is modern, clean, and has everything you need. The jacuzzi is perfect after a long day at the beach. Hosts are very accommodating.

location.description: Located in the heart of Candolim, just a 5-minute walk from Candolim Beach. Close to popular restaurants, cafes, and shops. The area is safe and well-connected.

cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation for 48 hours. After that, cancel up to 7 days before check-in and get a 50% refund, minus the service fee.
